normalization_policy.rule: No inferred timestamp may be promoted above its source precision. Publication time, event time, statement time, and first-indexed time remain distinct fields.

events.label: communications degradation observed
events.notes: Simultaneous degradation affected an AT&T FirstNet line and Astound fixed broadband; exact start and recovery times require device, carrier, or support records.

events.label: Iranian ballistic missile launch toward U.S. facilities in Jordan
events.notes: Populate only from preserved CENTCOM, Jordanian, or telemetry source. Do not substitute article publication time.

events.label: CENTCOM attempted surprise attack characterization
events.notes: Retain original platform timestamp, edit history, and archive hash.

events.label: Jordanian military interception disclosure
events.notes: Distinguish military statement issuance from Petra indexing and republication.

events.label: IRGC Notice No. 52 publication
events.notes: Preserve Persian original; connect IRNA Persian, Arabic, and English derivatives without treating translations as independent event confirmations.

events.label: U.S. executive punitive retaliation rhetoric
events.notes: Preserve exact wording and distinguish live remarks, transcript, social post, and secondary quotation.

events.label: U.S. strike campaign execution begins
events.notes: Do not infer authorization time from execution time.

events.label: Iranian after-action assessment
events.notes: Absence must be rechecked against official military and government channels before being recorded as bounded absence.
